run.note: The dedicated OCI job passed. The overall workflow failed only because the separate integration job also auto-ran the OCI test without first pulling alpine:3.20; its diagnostic annotation reported No such image.

coverage: network, PID and IPC namespace settings
read-only root filesystem and bounded /tmp storage quota

integrationJobIsolationIssue.diagnostic: OCI create failed: Error response from daemon: No such image: alpine:3.20
integrationJobIsolationIssue.cause: The general integration job detected Docker and auto-ran the live OCI test, but that job did not pull the operator-selected OCI image. The dedicated OCI job did pull the image and its lifecycle test passed.
integrationJobIsolationIssue.fix: The live test is now opt-in via BOB_OCI_REAL_TEST=1, set only by the dedicated OCI job after Docker and image preflight.
